extracted.stage: Divorce proceedings, acting for respondent, next hearing listed
extracted.summary: A family solicitor enquires about a £14,000 litigation loan for her client, the respondent in a divorce with around £297,000 of assets in dispute, ahead of a hearing at the Central Family Court on 4 September 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry to Lodestar Legal Finance, which we have logged for review. To take this further we will need your client's full name and contact details, confirmation of their role in the proceedings, a breakdown of the £14,000 sought (counsel, expert and your own fees), and supporting detail on the assets in dispute including property and pension valuations. It would also help to have the case number, the nature of the hearing listed for 4 September, and confirmation of the court and current stage of proceedings. Our criteria and application form can be issued once we have these basics. A member of the team will follow up with you directly.
